source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-20 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: All expected pixels/status indicators were observed on the exact fx-880BTG PLUS in ClassPad, 20 November 2026. All 52 observations accepted with full 192x63 LCD and status comparisons, no masks/referenceOnly exclusions. Saved directly into the project.
MathI CALC input/form/Run/result coverage: 2^(A/2) with A=3 gives 2.828427125; Abs(sqrt(x)-2) with x=3 gives 2-sqrt(3). Negative stored form values use the observed unary-minus glyph.

Actual negative-square-root failures carry error context. Back restores the original expression and targets the failing radical argument. Compared sqrt(x), A+sqrt(x), sqrt(x)+A, sqrt(x-2), and sqrt(A)+sqrt(x) with the first root valid and second invalid. No random/registered-function resampling is performed while locating a target.

EXE on a selected CALC variable opens an empty editor rather than advancing. EXE on an empty editor is ignored; Back restores the selected stored value; AC clears the draft while retaining editing. Direct typing and accepted drafts still advance to the next field or Run.
Three initial recovery IDs were renamed to the actual observed empty-A/after-A=9/empty-x states. Original pixels/statuses/keys are retained. Entering x=9 afterward gives sqrt(9)+sqrt(9)=6.

CALC arrows do not navigate variables/history while the empty editor is active. A probe including UP/DOWN followed by typing and Back verifies the state, not only an unchanged LCD. From a selected variable, DOWN moves through x to Run, and EXE uses retained values to give 6.

Typing 5 then AC and Back restores A=9 without committing 5. Reopening the original sqrt(x) failure and explicitly accepting x=4 recovers result 2. Numeric and control expectations are PLUS observations, not independent mathematical replacements.
